privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Balans is a learning pet project: an online ledger of income and expenses for small businesses. Here is a short summary of what data it stores and how that data is used.
privacy.dataPassword: Your email and password if you sign up with email. The password is stored only in encrypted form.
privacy.dataGoogle: Your email, name, and profile photo if you sign in with Google. Balans has no access to your Gmail, Drive, contacts, or other Google data.
privacy.dataContent: What you enter yourself: business name, categories, income and expense amounts, notes.
privacy.dataDemo: The demo uses anonymous sign-in: no email, no name. The demo business and everything you change in it are deleted after 24 hours.
privacy.whySignIn: So you can sign in to your account.
privacy.whyShow: To show your business's entries, totals, and charts to you and your team.
privacy.sharingNoSale: We don't sell your data and don't show ads.
privacy.sharingServices: Data is stored in Supabase (database and sign-in), and the site runs on Vercel. These services process data only to run Balans.
privacy.sharingIsolation: One business's entries are never visible to other businesses. A team member can't see totals or other people's entries.
privacy.cookiesText: Only for sign-in and your language choice, so you don't have to enter your password or pick a language on every page. No third-party analytics or advertising cookies.
privacy.deletionText: The owner can delete the business with all its entries, categories, and team: Settings → Delete business. To delete the account itself or ask a question, open an issue in the <link>GitHub repository</link>. Data is deleted permanently, with no backup.
